generationContext.text:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <Description>An OpenTelemetry .NET exporter that exports to Azure Monitor</Description>
    <AssemblyTitle>AzureMonitor OpenTelemetry Exporter</AssemblyTitle>
    <Version>1.11.0-beta.1</Version>
    <!--The ApiCompatVersion is managed automatically and should not generally be modified manually.-->
    <ApiCompatVersion>1.10.0</ApiCompatVersion>
    <PackageTags>Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry Exporter ApplicationInsights</PackageTags>
    <TargetFrameworks>$(RequiredTargetFrameworks)</TargetFrameworks>
    <IncludeOperationsSharedSource>true</IncludeOperationsSharedSource>
    <EnableConfigurationBindingGenerator>true</EnableConfigurationBindingGenerator>
    <DefineConstants>$(DefineConstants);AZURE_MONITOR_EXPORTER;</DefineConstants>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Versions are defined in eng/centralpackagemanagement -->
    <!-- Whenever updating OpenTelemetry dependencies, confirm that Test dependencies are also updated. -->
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
    <PackageReference Include="OpenTelemetry.PersistentStorage.FileSystem" />
    <PackageReference Include="OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Shared source from Azure.Core -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ArrayBufferWriter.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ConnectionString.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)EventSourceEventFormatting.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ExperimentalAttribute.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

proposals.subtype: Construct the ingestion client from supplied diagnostics and pipeline
proposals.explanation: The internal constructor retains supplied ClientDiagnostics and HttpPipeline, parses host into _endpoint and assigns v2.1 as the API version. It does not construct or validate the supplied pipeline's policies.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete constructor is supplied in the Customizations partial rather than inferred from generated output.

proposals.subtype: Retain ingestion messages for selected transport exceptions
proposals.explanation: The four InternalTrackAsync overloads prepare messages, disable automatic redirects through RedirectPolicy and await Pipeline.SendAsync. Caught exceptions call FailedToTransmit; when InnerException.Source is neither System.Net.Http nor System they dispose/rethrow, otherwise they return the message without rethrowing. A returned message therefore does not guarantee a successful response. Only the first enumerable overload explicitly rejects null body before request creation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The customization partial implements explicit send/error/disposal branches for enumerable and stored-byte payloads, with optional destination URIs.

proposals.subtype: Serialize telemetry sequences as newline-delimited JSON or forward stored bytes
proposals.explanation: CreateTrackRequest writes each TelemetryItem through NDJsonWriter.WriteObjectValue followed by WriteNewLine, converts that buffer into request content and supports an explicit track URI. Its stored-byte overload wraps the existing memory directly. DEBUG builds additionally call telemetry debug writers; their implementations and telemetry model serialization are not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit request-content adapters are implemented in the handwritten customization partial.

proposals.subtype: Build ingestion destinations with a fresh mutable URI builder for each request
proposals.explanation: CreateTrackUri resolves v2.1/track against a supplied ingestion URI. CreateRequest allocates a new RawRequestUriBuilder per message, resets it to the explicit destination or a lazily cached default track URI, and sets POST, JSON content/accept headers and content. BuildTrackUri appends the selected version and track path to _endpoint. This measures URI construction, not the excluded redirect policy's behavior.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete destination/request construction helpers are supplied in Customizations.

proposals.subtype: Construct availability telemetry from availability information
proposals.explanation: The added AvailabilityData constructor delegates version/ID/name/duration/success to another constructor, then assigns run location, message and the supplied properties dictionary and creates measurements. The LogRecord argument is not read in this body.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The model customization partial defines a concrete additional constructor.

proposals.subtype: Construct message telemetry with truncation and mapped severity
proposals.explanation: MessageData's added constructor retains supplied properties, initializes measurements, truncates a non-null message through the schema-length helper and requests a severity from LogsHelper using LogRecord.LogLevel. Numeric limits and the severity mapping implementation are excluded.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete log-record adapter constructor is supplied in the model customization partial.

proposals.subtype: Project OpenTelemetry metric kinds into telemetry datapoint fields
proposals.explanation: MetricDataPoint maps a metric name through an external standard-name dictionary when available and selects sum/gauge/histogram accessors by MetricType. Histogram count is retained only when <= int.MaxValue and min/max are assigned when available; unsupported types call the event source. No lower count bound or generated Value property type is established here.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The customization constructor contains explicit domain-specific Metric/MetricPoint branching.

proposals.subtype: Build metric envelopes with filtered dimensions or a resource sentinel
proposals.explanation: The MetricsData overload group creates a single MetricDataPoint and string properties, optionally removes four routing dimensions, drops overlong keys/null values, delegates array conversion and truncates other stringified values. Its version-only constructor creates a zero-valued _OTELRESOURCE_ datapoint. Routing constant values and formatting helpers are excluded.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete alternate constructors and routing-dimension filtering are implemented in Customizations/Models.

proposals.subtype: Convert activity semantics and overrides into dependency telemetry
proposals.explanation: RemoteDependencyData dispatches HTTP/database/messaging helpers or a server-address fallback, then applies nonempty Microsoft override attributes. The helpers select old/new semantic slots, set dependency fields and truncations, map known database systems to SQL and add a database-name property. The constructor supplies name/span ID/duration, treats any non-Error activity status as success, selects Azure/InProc type when applicable and delegates links/unmapped properties. External semantic/format helpers are not independently verified.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The model customization contains a complete activity adapter and concrete protocol-specific helper bodies.

proposals.subtype: Convert activity request semantics with status inference and overrides
proposals.explanation: RequestData selects old/new HTTP or messaging mappings, applies nonempty Microsoft URL/name/source/result overrides, assigns span ID/duration/response code and delegates links/properties. IsSuccess uses a nonzero parsed integer below 400 only for Unset HTTP activity status; otherwise it tests status != Error. The local requestName is assigned only by the supplied override-name branch, not an observed display-name fallback.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete activity conversion, protocol helpers and success inference are defined in the model customization partial.

proposals.subtype: Project runtime stack frames with method-unavailable fallback
proposals.explanation: The StackFrame constructor gets method information through an excluded helper, uses frame.ToString()/unknown assembly when absent, otherwise composes declaring type/method and assembly names, truncates strings, assigns frame level and omits a zero line number. GetStackFrameLength sums only stored method/assembly/file-name string lengths for the captured stack-budget consumer.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The customization partial implements a concrete runtime-to-model constructor and its length helper.

proposals.subtype: Initialize event telemetry from name and properties
proposals.explanation: The added TelemetryEventData constructor assigns name and the supplied properties dictionary and creates measurements after base(version). Its message and LogRecord parameters are not read; no local name truncation or message serialization is shown.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete additional constructor is present in Customizations/Models.

proposals.subtype: Project exception trees and append a truncation marker
proposals.explanation: TelemetryExceptionData requires LogRecord.Exception, initializes properties/measurements/severity/problem ID and recursively builds details for aggregate children or a single InnerException with parent links. Nested blank messages fall back to exception.Message; the root retains the caller's message. After traversal, more than ten details are reduced to the first ten plus a synthetic count-exceeded detail parented to the root, so the resulting list can contain eleven entries.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The customization constructor and recursive helper explicitly implement exception-tree projection and post-traversal trimming.

proposals.subtype: Project exception details with an endpoint-preserving bounded stack
proposals.explanation: TelemetryExceptionDetails validates exception/message, truncates message/type, uses the exception hash for ID and links OuterId to a parent. Its stack helper alternates last/first frames inward, inserts accepted frames centrally to preserve their order, stops at the frame-count or accumulated string-length budget and marks HasFullStack false when a limit stops traversal. The numeric schema budgets and external method-info helper are not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete model constructor and stack-selection algorithm are provided in Customizations/Models.

decisions.reason: The non-generated Customizations partial declares this constructor and directly stores the supplied diagnostics and pipeline while configuring the host and version. Its prebuilt-pipeline construction is a distinct handwritten client behavior; the claim does not assume anything about the pipeline's policies.

All four declared send overloads contain the cited exception-source check, diagnostic call, conditional disposal/rethrow and message return. The proposal also explicitly records automatic-redirect suppression on those same overloads; that behavior is already proposed, not an omission. A returned message is not proof of a successful response.

The cited handwritten CreateTrackRequest overloads visibly write one object and newline per item or wrap supplied bytes, including the explicit-URI variant. The proposal does not attribute unseen model or debug-writer implementations to these methods.

The cited helper declarations construct explicit/default track destinations, allocate a new request URI builder, and populate POST and JSON request fields. These are observable handwritten request-construction details, not a claim about the excluded redirect policy.

The Customizations model partial declares the cited constructor and its delegation and assignments exactly as described. This is an additional model constructor; the unused LogRecord parameter is acknowledged rather than assigned an invented effect.

The handwritten MessageData constructor initializes the stated model fields and invokes the cited truncation and severity helpers. Its pattern describes an alternate constructor and the proposal leaves the excluded helper semantics unresolved.

The Customizations constructor contains the name lookup, metric-type switch, histogram count bound, optional min/max and unsupported-type logging. The projection is tied to the telemetry metric schema, so a service-specific generatorAddressable assessment is reasonable without assuming external mapping contents.

The Customizations model partial declares the full cited constructor family: the Metric/MetricPoint overloads project filtered and formatted tags, and the version-only overload constructs the zero-valued _OTELRESOURCE_ datapoint. The sentinel was already explicitly included in the proposal; its shared unqualified constructor identity cannot be split into a distinct omission by adding a signature. Referenced routing and formatting helpers remain unverified.

The Customizations partial declares the cited constructor and protocol-specific helper bodies, including conditional overrides, old/new semantic-slot selection and final telemetry assignments. The description avoids asserting unseen helper implementations or TypeSpec coverage.

The RequestData constructor, IsSuccess helper and protocol-specific request mapping are declared in the cited handwritten partial. The proposed qualification that requestName has no locally observed non-override assignment is important and supported.

The StackFrame constructor and string-length helper are both declared in the Customizations partial. The cited branch handles missing method information as described, while the external method helper's implementation is not assumed.

The declared handwritten TelemetryEventData constructor assigns the supplied name and properties and initializes measurements. The proposal correctly notes that message and LogRecord are unused here, without extrapolating to generated code.

The recursion, nesting and ten-plus-marker trimming are supported, but the original wording implies a nullable root message is safely retained. The supplied TelemetryExceptionDetails constructor rejects null messages and ConvertExceptionTree substitutes exception.Message only for nested nodes, so the root's null-message behavior needs explicit qualification.

finding.subtype: Project exception trees and append a truncation marker
finding.explanation: TelemetryExceptionData requires LogRecord.Exception, initializes properties, measurements, severity and problem ID, and recursively constructs parent-linked details for aggregate children or a single InnerException. Nested missing or whitespace messages are replaced with exception.Message; the root passes the caller's message unchanged, and the supplied detail constructor throws if that message is null. When the traversal produces more than ten details, the first ten remain and a synthetic count-exceeded detail is appended, potentially leaving eleven entries.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The non-generated Customizations/Models partial declares the exception-tree constructor and recursive helper, including explicit traversal and trimming branches.

decisions.reason: The cited Customizations constructor maps exception details and delegates to the declared stack selector; its frame-ordering and count/length checks support the described bounded projection. The proposal does not invent numerical schema limits or external helper behavior.

limitations: Coverage is partial: eleven of 280 eligible source files were supplied. Exporter entrypoints, model TelemetryItem serialization, policies, response handling, transmitter/retry/storage code, semantic mappings, numeric schema limits and Live Metrics customizations are excluded.

All captured source is in Customizations/Models or the customized REST client and is tagged handwritten-marker. Generated counterparts and compiled/runtime behavior are absent; constructors are not proof that every conversion path is invoked by the exporter.

Model overloads are grouped by their real constructor symbols. Activity/exception helper algorithms are included with their consuming projection rather than split into duplicate per-field/tag instances. Standard property initialization, debug calls and imported helper names are not separate findings.

The internal send methods suppress only caught exceptions whose inner exception source matches the two literal source names. They can return messages without a demonstrated successful response. No retry/backoff, persistent-storage recovery, partial-ingestion handling or redirect-policy implementation is inferred.

NDJsonWriter, WriteObjectValue, Truncate, severity/problem-ID mappings, tag processors, link/property helpers and standard metric mappings are not supplied. The calls are factual wiring; their full formatting, redaction, schema-limit or runtime behavior is not asserted.

Several constructor inputs are unused in their supplied bodies, and RequestData's local requestName has no observed non-override fallback. The exception tree is fully traversed before its first-ten-plus-marker trimming; a null root message reaches a detail constructor that rejects null. These are bounded source observations, not fixes or executed failure claims.

Generic constructor/payload/URI shapes may be generator-addressable; OpenTelemetry-to-Application-Insights domain projection is not treated as a missing client generator feature merely because it resides in a TypeSpec-linked package.

The source project reports 1.11.0-beta.1 with ApiCompatVersion 1.10.0 and latestRelease metadata 1.10.0. No published-artifact comparison, SDK execution, telemetry export or historical-cause verification was performed.

Coverage is partial: 11 captured source files among 280 eligible files (400 discovered), with numerous named files skipped by the review budget. Findings and omissions describe only supplied evidence and cannot establish package-wide absence.

Generated partials, redirect policy, NDJsonWriter, metric mappings, schema constants and other referenced helpers are not supplied; generated-versus-handwritten conclusions rely on the supplied Customizations paths and the .NET guidelines, not a generated-code comparison.

No genuinely missed, nonoverlapping candidate was established in the supplied evidence. Automatic-redirect suppression and the resource sentinel are already included under their original proposal keys, not separate omissions. Accepted and revised findings are AI-reviewed rather than verified; human override decisions remain authoritative.

The source presents a nullable root exception message but the supplied details constructor rejects null. The review records the conflicting behavior rather than inferring a caller guarantee or an unseen fix.
